title: LLM Measurement
document_title: LLM Measurement: open-source tools for LLM usage questions
description: LLM Measurement provides open-source tools to answer questions about token spikes, distinct users, usage completeness and comparisons across teams and tools from existing telemetry, using keyed hashes instead of raw user or session IDs and no per-user metric labels.

title: Which user is driving my LLM token spike?
description: Usage jumped? Compare two periods and see which users and sessions account for the increase.

title: Who is tokenmaxxing? Find your heaviest AI token users
description: No spike needed: rank who uses the most tokens in a period, and see how concentrated usage is.

title: Why did our LiteLLM usage jump, and are the spend logs complete?
description: The same comparison straight from LiteLLM's spend logs, plus a check on whether the records are complete.

title: Prompt cache hit rate dropped after an update? Find whose uncached input grew
document_title: Prompt cache hit rate dropped after an update? Find whose uncached input grew
description: Prompt cache hit rate dropped after an update? Compare recorded cache shares and find which keys or sessions added uncached input with fleetdiff.

title: How do I see LLM usage per user without a metric label for every user?
description: Check a collector configuration with fleetdiff diagnose and keep user rankings out of metric labels.

title: How do I detect anomalies in LLM token consumption?
description: Scan retained LLM summary windows for unusual token usage, session concentration, tool errors and missing usage.

title: Do my LLM traces record token usage and user IDs?
description: Check a local OTLP capture for usage and identity fields that are present, missing or zero.

title: How do I count distinct LLM users without storing user IDs?
description: Estimate distinct LLM users using keyed hashes and fixed-memory sketches in Python, then merge compatible measurements across workers.

title: Why summaries instead of raw logs
description: Measured sharing, retention and attribution properties of keyed summaries, with pinned coding-agent data and labeled synthetic workloads.

title: For security reviewers
description: Data paths, identity handling, manual release verification and repository controls for LLM Measurement tools.
